description: The one definition of the V3 protected-staging approval rules. Read by the Python validator (deployment check and runtime, veda/modules/catalog/staging_approval.py), the staging build (app/scripts/v3-approval.mjs) and the Terraform plan (infra/terraform/modules/v3-approval). Each implements the rules exactly as written under 'rules' and reports the failing codes in the order of 'codes'. The shared conformance cases (api/tests/fixtures/v3_approval/cases.json) prove the three give identical decisions.
rules: Today is the current UTC date. A date is a JSON string matching date_pattern that is a real calendar day. 'Absent' means the key is missing or null. Names are compared after trimming and collapsing runs of space, tab, CR or LF to one space, then lower-casing.
NO_RECORD: there is no readable record file. MALFORMED: the file is not a JSON object. Either is reported alone.
SCHEMA: schema is not the policy schema. STATUS: status is not approved_status. ENVIRONMENT: environment is not the policy environment.
RELEASE: release is not a string matching release_pattern.
SCOPE: approval_scope is not an object whose version, protected, public_intake, three_d and video equal 'scope' exactly (booleans are JSON booleans) with media_delivery a JSON boolean.
REVOKED: status is revoked_status, or revoked_at or revocation_reason is present.
APPROVER: approver or author is not a string, either is empty after normalising, either contains the placeholder (case-insensitive), or the two are equal after normalising.
APPROVAL_DATE: approved_at is not a date. APPROVAL_IN_FUTURE: approved_at is a date after today.
REVIEW_WINDOW: review_by is not a date, or approved_at is a date and review_by is not after approved_at and at most max_review_days after it. REVIEW_REACHED: review_by is a date on or before today.

EXPIRY_POLICY: exactly one of expires_at and non_expiring_decision must be present; expires_at, when present, is a date after approved_at (if approved_at is a date); non_expiring_decision, when present, is a string of at least non_expiring_min_length characters after trimming. EXPIRED: expires_at is a date on or before today.

EVIDENCE: evidence is not an object whose keys are exactly git_evidence plus digest_evidence, each an object with a string reference of at least reference_min_length characters after trimming, git_sha (git_evidence) or sha256 (digest_evidence) a string matching its pattern.

DIGEST_MISMATCH: the bound digest (catalog_v3.approval_record_sha256 at plan and build; VEDA_CATALOG_APPROVAL_SHA256 at deployment and runtime) is not a string matching sha256_pattern equal to the SHA-256 of the record file's bytes.
RELEASE_MISMATCH (runtime only, on routes that serve the active release): release is not the active catalog release's code.

not a schema-2 V3 staging approval record
the record is not for staging
the record names no valid catalog release
the scope is not V3 on protected staging without public intake, 3D or video
the approver is missing, a placeholder or the author
the record has no valid approval date
the approval date is in the future
the review date is not after the approval and within 90 days of it
the review date has been reached
the record needs exactly one of an expiry date after the approval or an explicit non-expiring owner decision
evidence is missing, unknown or without its SHA
the record is not the one bound by digest
the record does not cover the active catalog release
